observations.statement: Poki lists desktop, mobile and tablet support as a hard requirement.
observations.excerpt: Desktop, mobile, and tablet support. Poki players play on everything. On mobile, cover the full screen in portrait or landscape, or both for the best experience. Force mobile control schemes on tablets.

observations.statement: Poki blocks all external requests by default, so fonts, assets and libraries must be bundled into the build.
observations.excerpt: No external requests. Poki blocks all external requests by default. Bundle fonts, assets, and libraries into your build.

observations.statement: Poki forbids external ad systems and outgoing links; its SDK handles ads.
observations.excerpt: No branding or external ads. Remove splash screens and outgoing links; your studio logo is welcome on the loading screen. Poki's SDK handles ads, so no other ad systems are allowed.

observations.statement: Poki requires games to stay playable with an ad blocker active.
observations.excerpt: No ad block prevention. Your game must stay playable with an ad blocker active. Messaging regarding ad blockers is handled on Poki's side.

observations.statement: Poki advises small file size because players tend to leave if loading takes more than 10 seconds; it does not state a numeric MB limit on this page.
observations.excerpt: Small file size. Players tend to move to another game if loading takes more than 10 seconds, and they load from everywhere in the world.

observations.statement: In-app purchases are not available on Poki; its ad system is the only monetization.
observations.excerpt: In-app purchases are not available. Poki's ad system is the only form of monetization.

observations.statement: Poki requires rewarded buttons to carry a video icon and never be green.
observations.excerpt: Misleading buttons. Rewarded buttons must carry a clear video icon, must never be green, and must never be positioned to trick the player into clicking them.

observations.statement: External link buttons on Poki must use PokiSDK.openExternalLink rather than navigating directly.
observations.excerpt: External Links: Any buttons that open external links when clicked (for example opening a YouTube channel or Discord community page) are required to fire the following SDK rather than directly leading to the URL. PokiSDK.openExternalLink('URL');
